text: Is the MaximumObjectGraphDepth change from 500 to 5000 in UntrustedData intentional and in scope?
options: Intentional, a separate deliberate security decision
why_it_matters: Per L9, a depth of 500 is a deliberate security limit. If accidental, this is a high-severity regression to revert. If intentional, it still needs its own test and rationale.
